comment: Maps semantic capability keys (from targets.py) to actual VST3 parameter names from A1.1 dump
notes: This mapping is authoritative for 16.5.69 production qualification.
If a capability_key is not in this mapping, the target is NOT YET RESOLVED to VST3.
VST3 parameter names are case-sensitive and come from A1_1_vst3_parameter_surface.json.
Known gaps: FXEQ parameters (Freq1/Freq2/Reso1/Reso2/Gain1/Gain2/LevelOut) and OSC1.Wavetable
These gaps indicate either: (1) missing FX processing in Serum 2.0.21 VST3, (2) FX not exported via IEditController, or (3) different parameter naming
Audit phases A3–A7 will systematically expand this mapping and surface any truly unreachable targets.
